entities.name: Román Torán Albero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Román Torán Albero was a Spanish chess player. He received the FIDE titles of International Master (IM) in 1954 and International Arbiter in 1957. He was FIDE Vice President (1982—1990) and a two-time Spanish Chess Championship winner.

entities.name: Román Torán Albero
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Román Torán Albero was a Spanish chess player. He received the FIDE titles of International Master (IM) in 1954 and International Arbiter in 1957. He was FIDE Vice President (1982—1990) and a two-time Spanish Chess Championship winner.
